name: contextquill
description: Turn real work into reviewed, high-quality LinkedIn content and learn which topics earn attention.

interface.shortDescription: Turn daily work into LinkedIn pipeline.
interface.longDescription: ContextQuill captures valuable ideas from real work, turns them into public-safe LinkedIn drafts, locks the exact human-approved version before publishing, and learns which topics and formats produce the most exposure.
